findings.title: Gate Notes creation by its own granted action
findings.detail: The shared new/edit fieldset checks only update permission. A read+create grant cannot create; read+update erroneously offers create.
findings.action: Gate by create for new drafts and update for existing drafts; verify action-specific fixtures without granting live permissions.
